title: Unreal Raspberry Pink 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Unreal Raspberry Pink is a deliciously delightful blend of ripe raspberries and candy that makes for a tastebud-tingling sensation. On the inhale you’ll find the fresh taste of blue raspberry coming through and the sweet flavour of pink bubblegum on the exhale. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mod vapes and sub-ohm tanks .
